captions.detailed: This 3D model features a frameless-glass flush sunroof cassette with a dual-section layout. The left side contains an open aperture framed by a thin, rectangular aluminum seal frame, with a tinted blue-grey glass panel resting on four guided corner slide shoes. The right side consists of a flat, solid black body rear panel. The glass panel is designed to retract fully rearward, sliding along twin prismatic rails to hide beneath the solid rear panel.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a flush sunroof cassette. It should feature a black base plate with a solid rear cover panel on one half and an open frame with aluminum rails on the other half. A tinted blue-grey glass panel must be mounted on guided corner slide shoes, designed to slide prismatically along the rails to retract beneath the rear panel.
captions.factory: The code constructs the sunroof assembly using an ArticulatedObject framework. It creates a base part representing the cassette body, extrusion profiles for the twin aluminum guide rails, and a rear cover panel using box primitives. The glass sunroof panel is modeled as a rounded box with a glass material definition and is attached to the base frame via a prismatic joint, allowing linear translation along the longitudinal axis.
